answer: Sponsored entry blocks bulk fake identities. A newcomer begins its voyage of verified work only when a sponsor locks a 100-credit bond behind it. The k-th identity needs a k-th fresh bond and work history, so 1,000 fakes lock 100,000 credits with no bulk discount. Idle identities decay each epoch; a sponsor whose sponsee cheats loses the bond and its right to sponsor again. Each sponsorship is checked at a public wharf where work records dock for audit, exposing shared funding. A tide of idle lookalikes cannot carry a sponsor; only steady work keeps the bond intact, so honesty costs once.
